description: This Java class 'RoutingDataSource' extends Spring's AbstractDataSource to dynamically determine and route database connections based on tenant context. It acts as a proxy data source that delegates connection requests to tenant-specific data sources, facilitating multi-tenancy support.

classes.name: RoutingDataSource
classes.description: A Spring-managed data source that routes connection requests to tenant-specific data sources based on context.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves a database connection from the target data source based on tenant context.

methods.name: determineTargetDataSource
methods.description: Determines and returns the appropriate tenant-specific data source.

methods.name: getConnection (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves a database connection using provided username and password from the target data source.
